name: Estella - Toki no Tsumi -
source:
This is the story of heroines drawn toward the darkest of fates.

Halloween—a night when the boundary between day and night dissolves,

and the sacred and the demonic hide behind their masks.

The three days leading up to that fateful night.

Those who were never meant to meet find their paths crossing time and again.

Feelings abandoned in the past.

Truths yet unknown.

Another possibility unfolding along a different path.

A single choice may save one person while hurting another.

Like lines connecting scattered stars, their paths intertwine and ultimately converge on a single ending.

What awaits them—salvation, or the unforgivable “The Sin of Time”?

Only the stardust shimmering above "ESTELLA" will witness it all.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4440930/ESTELLA__The_Sin_of_Time/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一段少女们一步步被卷向最漆黑宿命的故事。

万圣节——白昼与黑夜的界限悄然消融，

神圣与邪魔皆隐匿于假面之后的夜晚。

在那个宿命之夜来临前的三天时光里，

本不该相遇的人们，命运轨迹却一次又一次交错。

被遗弃在过去的感情。

尚未揭晓的真相。

沿着另一条道路延展开来的别样可能。

仅仅一次抉择，便可能拯救某个人，同时深深伤害另一个人。

犹如串联起漫天散落繁星的线条一般，她们的轨迹彼此交织，最终收束向唯一的结局。

等待着她们的究竟是救赎，还是不可饶恕的“时之罪”？

唯有在“ESTELLA”上空闪烁的星尘，将见证这一切。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4440930/ESTELLA__The_Sin_of_Time/]Steam[/url]]
